verdict.rationale: Locking an FX rate is a fair question for a business bank that sends international wires, so the axis applies. The evidence shows international wire payouts (docs-46, docs-53) and no-fee USD payments abroad (docs-7), but nothing documents an FX quote, a rate lock, or a time-limited rate window before a transfer completes. International wire support alone is an adjacent capability and earns no credit.
